entries.title: Joshua 23:1
segments: No fidelity to God, or usefulness to men, can keep off the approach of age, infirmity, or death.  This should be borne in mind, and incite all to do with their might what they are hastening, there is no work.

entries.title: Joshua 23:3
segments: The aged may recount the mercies of the Lord with great advantage to themselves and to their fellow men.

entries.title: Joshua 23:4
segments:
The great sea; the Mediterranean, which formed the western boundary of Canaan. 
 
Faith in God produces a permanent conviction of the truth of his promises, and leads men to act as if they knew that they would be fulfilled.

entries.title: Joshua 23:6
segments: The fact that God will do for us what we need, instead of leading us to neglect appropriate means, or to feel that they are less important, should lead us with fidelity to use them, because that is the only way effectually to secure his aid.

entries.title: Joshua 23:7
segments:
Neither make mention; the familiar mention of the names of idols would tend to lessen their abhorrence of them. 
 
Intimate connections with the wicked greatly increase the danger of becoming like them.

entries.title: Joshua 23:9
segments: Things are done by the Lord which are accomplished by human instrumentality.  Men use the means, and God renders them successful.

entries.title: Joshua 23:10
segments:
One man of you shall chase a thousand; however few they might be, and however numerous their enemies, they, in obeying God, would be able to overcome them. 
 
When God is on our side and works for us, we need fear no enemies, however numerous or strong, but we may go forward in duty, with assured confidence of final and complete victory.

entries.title: Joshua 23:11
segments:
Take good heed; be very careful. 
 
If we love and obey God, we shall be in all good efforts in the highest and best sense successful; but if we disregard his laws, and are governed by the principles and practices of the wicked, we may expect calamity and ruin.

entries.title: Joshua 23:14
segments: Going the way of all the earth; about to die.
The fulfilment of God's declarations in times past, should assure us of their fulfilment in time to come.
